title: Due on Receipt as the default shows only Move Customers
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the shop's default for new customers.
  • At least one customer holds Due on Receipt.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Due on Receipt" row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Move Customers" (person). Nothing else shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-N2: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold never show "Deactivate" (S1-R9 explains why on the lock icon).”
  • S2-N4: “The current default never shows "Make Default for New Customers"; its "Deactivate" and, for a term the shop created, "Delete Credit Term" show blocked with the default reason (S2-R1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Row menu: the current default"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-08-row-menu-the-current-default.png

The design's own words:

  • “Here Net 30 is the default. Make Default is left out, and Deactivate shows greyed with "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first."”
